events.event_name: DISCOVER SHIYENZE | Fashion Week Open Atelier
events.what_it_is: A three-day Fashion Week open atelier where visitors can meet designer Roselyne Shiyenze, explore and try on the collection, shop one-of-one pieces and textiles, and hear the stories behind the clothes.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free with RSVP. The organizer also advertises Kenyan tea and wine as part of the atelier experience; merchandise is sold separately.
events.caveats: The Eventbrite listing is published by Shiyenze Fashion and advertises free RSVP; no host-approval step is stated. Sunday is the final day. Merchandise is not free.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 12–6 PM at 87 George Street in Brooklyn. Use the Eventbrite listing for the free RSVP. Shiyenze's own site independently confirms its New York location at 87 George Street.

events.address: Jack & Charlie's No. 118, 118 Greenwich Avenue, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW Maison Perrier atelier at Jack & Charlie's offering on-site custom hat-and-scarf combinations hand-crafted by a resident seamstress.
events.what_is_free: The current event listing says the custom hat-and-scarf combinations are offered free on site and that the activation is open to the public.
events.caveats: The event details are currently supported by a current NYC event listing rather than a standalone Maison Perrier event page. Jack & Charlie's official site independently confirms the venue address. No RSVP or approval requirement is published. Custom items may be supply- or capacity-limited.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 11 AM–5 PM at Jack & Charlie's No. 118, 118 Greenwich Avenue. Walk-in public access is the currently published admission path.

events.event_name: NEST Cardamom Latte Café NYFW Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A one-day fragrance pop-up bringing NEST's Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum to life as a complimentary café experience in Chelsea Triangle.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free public access, complimentary Cardamom Lattes and fragrance sampling while supplies last.
events.caveats: Two current NYC event sources independently confirm September 14, Chelsea Triangle, free public access, complimentary lattes and fragrance sampling. NYC for FREE lists 10 AM–9 PM or while supplies last, while another current listing confirms a 10 AM start but not a guaranteed closing time. Treat 9 PM as the advertised maximum, not a guarantee that inventory lasts that long.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 beginning at 10 AM in Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District. No RSVP, ticket or approval requirement is published. Arrive earlier for the best chance at the complimentary latte and sampling.

occurrences.details: Free RSVP through the organizer's Eventbrite listing; no approval step stated.
Current listing describes the activation as open to the public; custom hat/scarf availability may be limited.
